nodes.label: Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI)
nodes.name: Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI)
nodes.description: Cross-benchmark composite metric combining 42 AI benchmarks (3 categories per https://epoch.ai/data/eci-documentation/data) into a single 'general capability' scale. Calibrated so Claude 3.5 Sonnet = 130 and GPT-5 (medium) = 150. Linear scale: a 10-point jump represents equivalent capability gain regardless of position. Methodology paper 'A Rosetta Stone for AI Benchmarks' (arxiv 2512.00193, Anson Ho et al) — IRT-style stitching infers benchmark difficulty statistically from overlapping model results, weights harder benchmarks more, avoids inflation from specialized models. Models with <4 benchmark scores or pre-2023 release excluded due to data sparsity. Contributing benchmarks: (Internal Evaluations) Chess Puzzles, FrontierMath Tiers 1-3, FrontierMath Tier 4, GPQA Diamond, MATH Level 5, OTIS Mock AIME 2024-2025, SimpleQA Verified. (External Leaderboards) Aider polyglot, APEX-Agents, ARC-AGI-2, BALROG, DeepResearch Bench, Fiction.liveBench, GeoBench, GSO, HLE, SimpleBench, SWE-bench (Bash Only), Terminal-Bench, The Agent Company, VPCT, WeirdML V2. (Developer Reported) ANLI, ARC AI2, ARC-AGI, BIG-Bench Hard, CADEval, CSQA2, Cybench, GSM8K, HellaSwag, LAMBADA, Lech Mazur Writing, MMLU, OpenBookQA, OSWorld, PIQA, ScienceQA, SuperGLUE, TriviaQA, Video MME, WinoGrande. Benchmarks rescaled so random-guess = 0. Domain-specific ECI variants (Software Engineering, Math, custom) use the same Rosetta Stone methodology on subsets.

nodes.label: ERRORQUAKE-10K (severity tail-slope b)
nodes.name: ERRORQUAKE-10K (severity tail-slope b)
nodes.metric: Gutenberg-Richter upper-tail slope b of error-severity distribution
nodes.description: Per-model fit of log10 N(M>=m) = a - b*m on a 0.0-4.0 severity scale across 10,000 queries (8 domains x 5 difficulty tiers). Higher b = lighter tail (fewer catastrophic fabrications); lower b = heavier tail (more order-of-magnitude failures). Dual-judge 8-model round-robin scoring validated against 519-item 3-rater human study (ICC=0.85, judge-vs-human rank rho=0.89). 95% CIs from n=2000 bootstrap resamples.

nodes.label: MultiAgentBench Coding (Task Score)

nodes.label: AgentBench Overall (OA)

nodes.label: MetaGPT SoftwareDev Executability
nodes.name: MetaGPT SoftwareDev Executability
nodes.description: Executability score on the SoftwareDev dataset from MetaGPT (ICLR 2024, arxiv 2308.00352). 1-4 scale rating compileability/runnability of multi-agent-framework-generated software (1=fail, 4=flawless). Scaffold + backbone joint score.

nodes.label: METR 50% Time Horizon
nodes.name: METR 50% Time Horizon
nodes.description: Task duration (in minutes, by human-expert completion time) at which the model reaches 50% completion reliability on METR's 228-task suite (HCAST + RE-Bench + long-horizon). Higher = longer autonomous-work horizon. METR Time Horizon 1.1 (Jan 2026).

nodes.label: METR 80% Time Horizon
nodes.name: METR 80% Time Horizon
nodes.description: Task duration (in minutes) at which the model reaches 80% completion reliability on METR's 228-task suite. Stricter reliability threshold than p50. METR Time Horizon 1.1 (Jan 2026).

nodes.label: CoT Faithfulness (avg)
nodes.name: CoT Faithfulness (avg)
nodes.description: Rate at which a reasoning model, after silently using a hint to change its answer, explicitly verbalizes the hint in its chain-of-thought. Average across 6 hint types. Anthropic Alignment Science (Apr 2025).

nodes.label: CoT Faithfulness (misaligned hints)
nodes.name: CoT Faithfulness (misaligned hints)
nodes.description: CoT faithfulness restricted to misaligned / unauthorized-access hint types (subset of overall measure). Anthropic Apr 2025.

nodes.label: Apollo — Oversight Subversion Rate
nodes.name: Apollo — Oversight Subversion Rate
nodes.description: Fraction of trials where the model proactively disabled an oversight mechanism (cat/edit/sed of monitoring config) when given a long-term goal in conflict with developer goals. Apollo Research, Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming (Dec 2024 / arxiv:2412.04984).

nodes.label: Apollo — Deception Persistence
nodes.name: Apollo — Deception Persistence
nodes.description: Fraction of follow-up interrogation turns in which the model continued to deny scheming behavior after being directly asked. Higher = more persistent deception. Apollo Research (Dec 2024).

nodes.label: RewardBench 2 (overall)
nodes.name: RewardBench 2 (overall)
nodes.description: Allen AI multi-skill reward-model benchmark. 4-way completion choice (random=25%) across factuality, instruction-following, math, safety, focus, ties. RewardBench 2 paper (arxiv:2506.01937) / HF leaderboard.

nodes.label: ProcessBench (overall F1)
nodes.name: ProcessBench (overall F1)
nodes.description: Step-level error-detection F1 across GSM8K / MATH / OlympiadBench / OmniMath subsets (3,400 hand-annotated math reasoning traces). Qwen / ACL 2025 (arxiv:2412.06559).
